integrity: Exact independent finite enumeration and root check included; infinite-domain theorem established by symbolic lag calculation and inequality argument, not by finite checker.
scientific_limitations: Assumes stationary symmetric binary first-order Markov sampling, linear words and interior 0<p<1; not claimed for asymmetric/nonstationary/cyclic laws; historical-priority comparison of broader general covariance framework remains qualified.
title: A parity-dependent covariance threshold for opposite singleton runs in a binary Markov chain
